title: The Movie That Changed You
description: Talk about a movie that left a deep impact on you. Why did it move you?
viewpoints: What emotions did it bring out?
Have you watched it again after that first time?

title: The Moral Dilemma
description: If you found a wallet full of cash on the street, what would you do?
viewpoints: Would your choice change if no one was watching?
Do you think honesty is situational?

title: Faith Under Pressure
description: Have you ever struggled to hold onto your faith during tough times?
viewpoints: What helped you stay grounded?
Is doubt a part of belief?

title: Music Time Machine
description: If you could attend any concert from any era, which would it be?
viewpoints: Why that artist or band?
Would you want to meet the artist backstage?

title: Redefining Success
description: What does success mean to you personally?
viewpoints: Has your definition of success changed over time?
Do you think society defines success wrongly?

title: The Unpopular Opinion
description: Share an opinion you have that most people disagree with.
viewpoints: Have you ever been criticized for it?
Would you ever change your mind?

title: What Is Worship to You?
description: Describe what true worship looks and feels like in your life.
viewpoints: Is it more than singing?
How do you worship in daily life?

title: Would You Rather?
description: Would you rather have unlimited time or unlimited money?
viewpoints: Why would you choose one over the other?
How would your choice change your life?

title: Friendship Check-In
description: What do you think makes a friendship last through the years?
viewpoints: What qualities do you value most in a friend?
When was the last time you truly appreciated a friend?

title: Battle of the Eras
description: Would you prefer to live in the past, present, or future?
viewpoints: Which era feels like 'home' to you?
What about today would you take back with you?

title: Describe Your Prayer Life
description: Is your prayer life structured, spontaneous, or something else?
viewpoints: How has your prayer life evolved?
What challenges you in prayer?

title: Guilty Pleasures
description: Share something small you secretly enjoy that others might find silly.
viewpoints: Why do you think you love it?
Would you ever admit it to others?

title: Doubt in Faith
description: Have you ever doubted God? How did you process it?
viewpoints: Was there a turning point?
Did someone help you during that season?

title: Music That Moves You
description: What song can instantly lift your mood?
viewpoints: Is there a memory tied to that song?
Would you share it with someone close to you?

title: Choosing Joy
description: How do you actively choose joy during difficult times?
viewpoints: Is it a mindset or an action?
Who or what helps you refocus?
